notes.content: Check out both of our new games in this special [b]Bundle[/b]!

notes.content:

Jousting VR is now available on Oculus Store. Rated Gold by our King.

notes.title: Halloween update
notes.content:
Welcome back fellow knights! We have a Halloween related special for you.
New spooky map, FOUR different pumpkin helmets and the last boss missing a head? Sounds like a challenge!
We would also like to announce a discount pack including both of our recwnt games for some festive marathon - Jousting VR and KAIJU MONSTER VR.

notes.title: Release Stream
notes.content: No Guts, No Glory! JOUSTING VR | Out NOW | Indie VR Game

notes.title: Get ready for the action
notes.content:
[h1]The time has finally come! [/h1]
All of the horses in stables are getting impatient and it is time for the jousting tournament to begin. Are you ready? 
Put on your best armour and join us for the release of Jousting VR!

We care deeply about our games and we are constantly working on making them the best experience possible. Therefore your feedback is really important and highly appreciated.

notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.content:
The new and updated demo is out now for all of you knights waiting out there!
We've changed the SDK to OpenXR so now the game works identically on all listed headsets.

notes.title: Best present for Valentine's Day
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35377707/7ddee3b0c54210d96016c7c5a4a377d63bb32922.png[/img]

What sort of present is ideal for Valentine's Day?

Flowers? 🌹 Clothes? 👕 

For a gamer? 

GAMES!! 🎮

As a token of our love for gamers on the occasion of the Valentine's Day celebration, we have prepared special discounts for nearly all Gaming Factory games with a bundle cheaper than a bouquet of flowers.

Check it out: 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24600/Valentine_Indie_Games_Bundle/



Let's celebrate together. Keep smiling and have fun playing.

Gaming Factory Team
